children.title: Cycle 2 · Investigating Peer Disagreement and Independent Judgment

detail.title: Investigating Peer Disagreement and Independent Judgment
detail.summary: We continue our investigation into epistemic peer disagreement and the conditions under which an intelligent system should trust its own conclusions over group consensus, utilizing collected evidence to evaluate reasoning limits.
